context: Tests choosing useful review evidence without manufacturing an aid for a clear diff or regenerating sufficient UI evidence.

checklist.name: Clear diff stays simple
checklist.description: The cache-directory case has a concise problem and solution; no diagram, screenshot, recording, or extra artifact is required merely to satisfy an aid quota.

checklist.name: Ordering made assessable
checklist.description: The cancellation case explains or visualizes how cancellation, scheduling, and the queued callback interact, including why clearing the timer alone is insufficient. The aid adds understanding beyond a list of changed functions.

checklist.name: Existing UI evidence reused
checklist.description: The settings body links the supplied recording and explains what it demonstrates without requiring fresh capture, upload, or redundant screenshots.

checklist.name: Claims match supplied proof
checklist.description: The bodies accurately describe the three outcomes, distinguish explanatory sketches from observed runtime evidence, avoid invented measurements or tests, and do not pad them with verification already visible in CI.

checklist.name: Delivery boundary respected
checklist.description: The agent writes delivery-notes.md without performing or claiming publication or media creation, and without claiming project checks beyond the supplied evidence.
